notes.title: Update 0.6.4.0!!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33663439/df37db0fb4237aa7757b289fdfdd96d85690237b.jpg[/img]
[b]Hello Monsters!![/b]


This time we feel we have to start with an apology for such a long time without any response.

We must be honest with you, it was a difficult period for our company where we had to reconcile work on the Monster League and fight for survival while working on other projects.

We would like to assure everyone that the work on the game is continued, however we cannot commit one hundred percent to our beloved game anymore, even though everyone in the company dreamed that the perfect scenario of working exclusively on Monster League would stay true throughout the whole project.

Keeping the deadline of six months to complete the game had become impossible, but extending the working time allowed us to fix our finances.
We will continue to work on improving the game as well as adding content to it. We are currently at the stage of finishing maps to all modes and the next step will be to create new characters and vehicles.

We hope you will continue to support us and the Monster League game. 

We have just uploaded a new update containing many performance improvements and two additional maps where you can have fun with your friends! :)

Thank you!
Render Cube Team
---------------------------

notes.title: NEW UPDATE ARRIVED - 0.6.1.0 !!!
notes.content:
ːsteamhappyː Hello Monsters! ːsteamhappyː

We have another update for you that introduces some cool things. The most important is the Tutorial, thanks to which you will learn the secrets of driving. Another important change is the behavior of the vehicles when turning, we have improved the "heaviness". Additionally, spectator mode has been added for other players.

The whole list of patches below, have a nice game! :

[h1]0.6.1.0[/h1]

[h1]Added:[/h1]
[list]
[*] A tutorial
[*] A possibility to watch the other players' driving after completing the race in network games
[*] Brazilian Portuguese language (special thanks to Samurai)
[*] Character avatars on the progress bar of the race
[/list]
[h1]Changed:[/h1]
[list]
[*] The duration of slowdown and freeze has been reduced
[*] Delays in vehicle control have been reduced
[*] The turning intensity has been related to the speed of the kart (the higher the speed, the weaker the turn)
[*] Vehicle's grip on slippery surfaces has been reduced (eg hockey rinks)
[*] Vehicle grip on non-slippery surfaces has been improved
[*] The maximum number of laps in the race have been increased to 10
[/list]
[h1]Fixed:[/h1]
[list]
[*] The restart of game mode in network games
[*] The blocked charging of the turbo bar during drifting and after the turbo bar had dropped to zero
[*] The disappearing frog and basilisk at the reset of the bot vehicle
[*] The blocking of the double jump
[*] The freezing of the vehicle after getting hit by a snowball
[*] The missing character symbols on banners in network games
[*] Many of the incorrect physics of the vehicle have been corrected
[*] The switching off of the improved shield when in contact with traps (chandelier and stone roller)
[*] Corrected the incorrect behavior of AI in football and hockey with disabled crates
[*] Mouse support in the menu
[*] Numerous UI elements
[/list]

notes.content:

ːsteamhappyː Hello Monsters! ːsteamhappyː

We have another update for you in which we changed many things and added a new racing map - Vampire Woods. This is a map with the lowest level of difficulty. We are currently working on a tutorial that will introduce everyone to the secrets of drift, turbo and some cool things that you can do with them :).

notes.title: Monster League Early Access Premiere!
notes.content:
ːsteamhappyː [b] Hello Monsters![/b] ːsteamhappyː

On the occasion of the premiere of our game we have great news for you. Monster League is available with a [b]30% discount[/b]!

This price will be valid until the end of "Halloween Sale" on Steam. It is a gift from us for you, we hope that you will like our game. See you on the track!

[b]Here are some release notes:[/b]

[b]Known issues Online:[/b]
- when host minimizes game, it pauses for everyone without any information at interface;
- sometimes if you're drifting and you get a lag, character can stuck in drift and you have to start drifting again to get out of it;
- collizions can be a little unsynchronized for now.

[b]Known issues UI:[/b]
- mouse navigation in menu is not finished yet;
- in languages different than english, some words may extend beyond the sizes of the buttons.
- the Chinese language is not working in the current version at the moment but we are working on making it available as soon as possible!

And other, like problems with collisions with environment.

We are aware with most of them and keep fixing them.


Thank you and have fun! ːsteamhappyː
